rawItems.title: Cambridgeshire road compensation payouts double to £217,643 as MP demands action
rawItems.content: A rising compensation bill is piling pressure on Cambridgeshire County Council to improve the condition of its roads after payouts to motorists more than doubled in a year. North West Cambridgeshire MP Sam Carling has called for action after compensation payments reached £217,642.65 in 2025/26. The increase follows complaints about road conditions, particularly in northern Huntingdonshire and rural communities including Ramsey and Bury. Mr Carling said: “Residents deserve roads that are safe, repairs that last, and a council that takes responsibility.
